The king said to her, “What ails you?” She answered, “Truly I am a widow, and my husband is dead.
Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?
Will you show partiality to him? Will you contend for God?
For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.
Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.
Lying lips are an abomination to Yahweh, but those who do the truth are his delight.

people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

translations.web: He said, “Are you really my son Esau?” He said, “I am.”
translations.bsb: Again he asked, “Are you really my son Esau?” And he replied, “I am.”
